_comment: How a time-series hand-off ADDRESS is spelled, on the three sides that spell it. `prefix` and `vectors` pin the percent-encoding of the fileServer path; `routable_levels` pins the LEVEL SEGMENT of /go/ts/<survey>/<station>/<level>, which is part of the same address and was the one statement no shared file held: the engine derived it, the route table emitted it and the portal's chooser re-declared it, so a sixth token would have published and routed while staying invisible in the UI. IN RENDER ORDER. level2 is absent BY RULING (D19), not by omission.

vectors.name: plain_path
vectors.why: the ordinary case: nothing to escape, and `/` survives as the separator

vectors.name: space_and_brackets
vectors.why: THE CORPUS VECTOR (NVP_2019): only the encoded form answers 200

vectors.name: leading_slashes_stripped
vectors.why: a register row written with a root slash must not double the separator

vectors.name: surrounding_whitespace_trimmed
vectors.why: a YAML value with stray whitespace is the same file

vectors.name: sub_delims_are_escaped
vectors.why: !'()* are escaped here and left alone by encodeURIComponent, so the JS mirror must not delegate to it

vectors.name: percent_is_itself_escaped
vectors.why: a literal % must not be read as the start of an escape

vectors.name: query_and_fragment_cannot_split_the_route
vectors.why: ? and # would end the path at the client if they survived

vectors.name: colon_at_and_tilde
vectors.why: : and @ are escaped; ~ is unreserved and survives

vectors.name: non_ascii_becomes_utf8_bytes
vectors.why: one code point, its UTF-8 bytes, one %XX each

vectors.name: astral_code_point_is_one_character_not_two
vectors.why: THE CLASS THAT KILLS THE MIRROR: a code point above the BMP is two UTF-16 code units in JavaScript, so a per-code-unit replace hands encodeURIComponent a lone surrogate and it throws URIError. Python's quote() encodes it correctly, so only a vector can hold the two together

vectors.name: unreserved_survive_untouched
vectors.why: the unreserved set is a fixed point of the encoder

vectors.name: backslash_and_quotes
vectors.why: a Windows-style separator is a filename character here, not a path split
